title: Credit Card Float: The $1,100 Trick Rich People Use
hook: Banks give you 55 free days to pay — and wealthy Americans earn $1,100 a year just by using that window strategically.
angle: Most credit card content is fear-based. This flips it — how to weaponize the float against the bank instead of letting the bank use fear against you.
audience: Anyone who pays their credit card in full monthly and has access to a high-yield savings account
